name: x3
title: Triplet rate matrix constructed from nucleotide rates

args.name: submodel
args.description: The nucleotide substitution model applied at each of the three positions

args.name: a
args.description: The triplet alphabet, including a codon alphabet

description:
Construct a rate matrix on a triplet alphabet, including a codon alphabet, from a nucleotide rate matrix. The same nucleotide model applies at all three positions. Each instantaneous substitution changes one nucleotide; the target alphabet determines which triplets are allowed.

Stationary inputs produce stationary models. For stationary non-reversible inputs, equilibrium frequencies are recalculated from the constructed rates.

For non-equilibrium inputs, root frequencies are calculated by multiplying the nucleotide frequencies at the three positions, then normalizing over the allowed triplets or codons.
examples: F81 +> x3 +> dNdS      # equivalent to MG94
